Checked: (1) buf_ss/crtc/vl/vr are read only at slot 2 (buffer_to_view's one call, X=2; buf_vl_lo/hi+2 in the zone code); no tool or other source reads them, so view_to_buffer(back)'s 8 stores are dead (render_reset's per-screen writes are likewise never read). X=back and A (overwritten by LDA buf_lives,X) are kept. (2) Skipping buffer_to_view(2) when pending_n=0: the live view (&00,&01,&B0-&B3,&BA,&BB, no aliases in zp.6502) is written only by scroll_screen_left/right and init in game.6502 (logic, not called in render), prebuild (before view_to_buffer(2), and restored inside it), history_to_view (only inside the pending_n<>0 loop), buffer_to_view and restore_game_zp (end of render); no indexed zp store in render-time code reaches them; the irq does not write them. So with pending_n=0 the view already equals buf[2], and restore_game_zp's reliance on it (render_zp.6502:129) still holds; ren_plot_lives in that path sees the same screen start. (3) LSR/EOR #1/TAY maps 1->1, 2->0 as before; pending_n is 0..2 (one history_push per pass via update_screen, observer/rewind push+render each time; zone and lives code make the same assumption). (4) Not protected (grind_config PROTECT is game.6502 only), not generated, not raster-timed (render is pass-locked); bank 4 ROMSEL &04, ACCCON unchanged; size: entry -3, JSR view_to_buffer -3, SKIP 6 restores, so .lives_drawn and everything after keep their addresses; only the two branches' distances change (BEQ scrolled +8, BNE +6), still in range. Cycles recounted: pending_n=0 saves 70 (LDX#2+JSR buffer_to_view) + 68 (LDX back+JSR view_to_buffer) (the LDX back stays), 138, +1 if BEQ scrolled now crosses a page; pending_n=1 or 2 saves 68 + 1..2 at the entry, so the measured 119 a pass is consistent with the mix.
